paragraphs.text: Stephan , also referred to as It Came from Planet Glurg , is an alien ooze who resides in Myra the Magnificent's Intergalactic Astrotorium of Fun .

Stephan holds a grudge stemming from the fact that no one refers to him by his name. He is seen only as a being who destroys things, not as an individual. Planet Glurg is his home and he is one of many who come from it. In defense of the Astrotorium, Stephan in Glurganese is 3000 characters long and hard to pronounce.
As he did not receive enough love as a child, Stephan has self esteem issues and takes people's identities in hopes of acceptance. He only wants to be loved.
